# Search: "keyboard"

3 results.

## 1. Foundation: accessibility › Keyboard

Every interactive element must be reachable and operable with the keyboard.

## 2. @leafygreen-ui/combobox › README › Keyboard interaction

Arrow keys move the highlight through the options. Enter selects the highlighted option, and Backspace removes the last selected chip when multiselect is enabled.

## 3. @leafygreen-ui/combobox › Design guidelines › Accessibility

Always provide a visible label. Selected chips must be removable with the keyboard.
